evidence.change: nine workflow job lanes changed from ubuntu-latest to self-hosted

substantive_deltas.boundary: The merge makes persistent self-hosted execution canonical for these lanes. It does not prove trusted-head admission, ephemeral isolation or cleanup for pull_request-origin code.
The 404 is an expected authorization denial, not evidence that the private repository is absent. It measures repository-token visibility only and does not attest runner-host state isolation.

The run used temporary fixtures and proves import-path mechanism equivalence only. Python -P/PYTHONSAFEPATH blocks automatic unsafe prepends but does not authorize PYTHONPATH, site, .pth, symlink targets or artifact identity. No Clay checkout, WP02 verdict or final target acceptance occurred.

rules: The two persisted copies of run 31723833122 are one run lineage and count once.
The execution and persistence jobs of run 31723833075 are one run lineage and count once.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN denial can coexist with a cross-job authority channel through persistent self-hosted host state.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A denied cross-repository token probe is sufficient evidence that a persistent self-hosted runner cannot influence later trusted jobs.
testable_hypotheses.test: On an isolated disposable replica, let an untrusted PR lane write randomized canaries to workspace siblings, tool caches, process table, user startup paths and allowed temp locations; then run a trusted push lane on the same runner and require zero canary recovery, zero surviving process and a clean-image attestation.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Across preregistered adversarial variants, no state channel survives and clean-image identity is independently attested before every trusted job.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: -P/PYTHONSAFEPATH improves path shape but cannot by itself establish the authority or identity of imported code.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Matching behavior under -P or PYTHONSAFEPATH is sufficient import-provenance evidence.
testable_hypotheses.test: Cross product PYTHONPATH injection, user-site/.pth/sitecustomize, symlink retarget, same-name replacement and zip import; bind expected module origin, content hash and admitted manifest before execution.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Every unauthorized replacement is rejected solely by -P/PYTHONSAFEPATH while all admitted fixtures remain accepted.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Green trusted-push mechanism runs are statistically and causally insufficient to validate untrusted pull_request execution on the same persistent runner fleet.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Successful push receipts transfer directly to PR execution safety because the workflow and runner labels are identical.
testable_hypotheses.test: Separate event-origin strata; compare trusted push with controlled untrusted PR canaries under identical workflow bytes and runner labels, then measure host-state residue and later trusted-job influence.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Event origin has no effect on reachable host state or later-job influence under an independently verified isolation boundary.

new_concepts.name: Token Scope / Runner State Scope Split
new_concepts.definition: API authorization can be repository-bounded while the execution host remains a wider, persistent authority surface.

new_concepts.name: Path Shape Is Not Artifact Authority
new_concepts.definition: A safer sys.path construction constrains lookup order but does not identify, admit or attest the code found there.

new_concepts.name: Authority Shadow Residue
new_concepts.label: abgefahren / testable
new_concepts.definition: Untrusted code may leave non-token state that is inert in its own job yet becomes authoritative when a later trusted job consumes the same host.

new_concepts.name: Green Push Mirage
new_concepts.label: abgefahren / counterfactual
new_concepts.definition: A cluster of real green push receipts can make a shared runner look safe while never sampling the event origin that carries the adversarial code boundary.

routing.impulse: Keep pull_request-capable persistent self-hosted lanes blocked from semantic or release credit until trusted-head admission or independently attested ephemeral clean isolation exists; execute the residue-canary matrix only on a disposable replica, never the productive Harness.
Model token authority and host-state authority as distinct edges. Persist HTTP 404 as EXPECTED_SCOPE_DENIAL and bind runner image/generation, event origin, cleanup and next-job lineage separately.

Extend the import-path receipt from path flags to artifact admission: resolved path, device/inode or immutable object, content hash, manifest/signature, sys.path, PYTHONPATH, site state and loaded-module origin. Preserve current 20x run as mechanism-only.
Apply event-origin stratification to causal claims: trusted-push broadcasts cannot stand in for adversarial PR lesions, and repeated jobs from one host fleet remain one correlated evidence family.

primary_sources.use: GitHub states self-hosted runners lack clean ephemeral guarantees and may be persistently compromised by untrusted workflow code.
GITHUB_TOKEN permissions should be least-privilege; additional authority requires a separate installation token or secret.
-P/PYTHONSAFEPATH only prevents automatic prepending of potentially unsafe path entries; PYTHONPATH and site-dependent paths remain separate controls.
